subject: Runway liaison: presenter pack timeline & boarding logistics
message_1_subject: Greenleaf workshop — confirming onsite agenda and read-aheads
message_1_body:
Hi Vivek & Marissa,

Thanks again for taking point on the onsite next month. We got final approval from our director and want to lock the agenda and presenter owners this week so we can circulate the read-ahead bundle to the execs. A few asks from our side: 

- Can you share a one-page run-of-play (60/90/120-minute options) and indicate which talks will be run by Redwood vs. Greenleaf?
- Who will own the 20-min product demo and the 10-min Q&A? We need names for travel bookings.
- We prefer read-aheads (deck + 2-page context memo) delivered by EOD next Tuesday (2027-05-25). Is that feasible?

Also attaching a short brief with the objectives and attendee seniority. Final headcount is 18 (10 Greenleaf, 8 vendor/partners). We will host at our DC office; arrival window is 08:30–09:00 on the day.

Can you confirm travel window recommendations (recommended arrival day, hotel block) so our ops team can coordinate logistics?

Appreciate it — Elena

Attachment: Greenleaf_Onsite_Objectives_brief.pdf
message_2_subject: Re: Greenleaf workshop — confirming onsite agenda and read-aheads
message_2_body:
Elena — thanks for the brief and the headcount. High level: yes, we can meet the read-ahead deadline with the timeline below. Marissa and Irene are copied to own decks and logistics respectively. Draft agenda (we'll finalize after your sign-off):

- 09:00–09:15 Arrival, quick coffee and exec welcome (Greenleaf lead)
- 09:15–09:35 Context & objectives (Greenleaf — Director Mills)
- 09:35–10:10 Product demo & use cases (Redwood — Vivek / Product)
- 10:10–10:25 Short break + networking
- 10:25–11:00 Deep-dive: cost & ops (Redwood — Marissa)
- 11:00–11:20 Q&A / next steps (Joint)

Presenter owners (proposed): Vivek (demo), Marissa Cole (ops deep-dive), Robert Mills (Greenleaf welcome & context). If Greenleaf has another preferred speaker for the 10m context, flag and we'll swap.

Read-ahead plan:
- Tue 5/25 EOD: consolidated deck + 2-page read-ahead memo (deliverable).
- Wed 5/26 morning: logistics email with hotel block, travel playbook, and final attendee list.

Attachments I'm sharing now: Presenter_Packet_v3.zip (slide template, speaker timing slide, AV checklist). Marissa — can you take the slide template and turn it into the read-ahead deck by Tue EOD? Irene — please draft travel itinerary and hotel suggestions for DC (recommend two hotels within 10–15 min of the office).

I'll book Vivek's travel once presenters are confirmed. If Greenleaf can confirm arrival window preference (earlier/later), we'll align the routing.

— Vivek

Attachment: Presenter_Packet_v3.zip (contains template and speaker instructions)
message_3_subject: Re: Runway liaison: presenter pack timeline & boarding logistics
message_3_body:
Vivek / Irene — quick internal checklist and asks so we can hit Tue EOD: 

Presenter packet checklist (what I'll produce):
- Consolidated deck (master deck) with slide slots for each presenter (I will assemble).
- 2-page read-ahead memo: executive summary + success metrics (drafted).
- Speaker one-pagers: 1 per presenter with talking points and time cues (Irene, can you confirm audience level and any Greenleaf-specific jargon we should avoid?).
- AV & room needs: I'll use the AV checklist in the packet; if anyone needs a laptop dongle or local clicker note it here.

Who owns which slide blocks (proposed):
- 09:35–10:10 demo: Vivek (I will create 2 framing slides + 1 closing slide)
- 10:25–11:00 ops deep-dive: Marissa (I will draft detailed ops and cost slides)

Logistics note for travel bookings (Irene):
- Recommend arrival day: Monday evening (5/30) for Thursday workshop? Wait — workshop date is Thursday 06/03 per Elena's brief? Need to confirm the actual workshop date; Elena, can you re-confirm the calendar invite date so we don't mis-time bookings.
- Hotel block request: 10 rooms for 3 nights, ask for corporate rate and early check-in.

I'll upload the draft master deck to the shared folder by Mon 5/23 COB so reviewers have 48 hours. If we need more time on the read-ahead, propose Wed 5/26 EOD as fallback.

Quick ask to Greenleaf ops: please confirm the room layout (boardroom vs. theater) and whether lunch will be onsite. That affects slide printouts and seating.

— Marissa

message_4_subject: Re: Greenleaf workshop — confirming onsite agenda and read-aheads
message_4_body:
Thanks Vivek & team — confirmed. The workshop date is Thursday 2027-06-03 (apologies for not including earlier). Boardroom layout works; lunch will be provided onsite.

Arrival window confirmed: 08:30–09:00. Please send the final read-ahead link by Tue 2027-05-25 EOD. Hotel block: The Jefferson or Kimpton Glover Park are preferred — both ~12–15 min from our office.

Looking forward to the demo.

— Robert
